answer: The falcon test I would run is Verified bed and breakfast registration with tourism authority attestation: a registration the authority renews after inspections, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the pearl of that gap is the whole defence in one line. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the zephyr of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
